text:
maria: heads-up — multiple deploys to gpu-pool-1 are failing after the RBAC refactor. pods crash on startup with KMS decrypt errors. looks like a permission regression. :rotating_light:

satish: exact error from runtime logs? can you paste the stack / pod name?

maria: pasted below from runtime-agent on gpu-node-07:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z ERROR runtime: secret.decrypt failed: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=access denied to kms:Decrypt for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/model-kms/cryptoKeys/primary
pod=redwood-infer-128-xyz container=runtime-agent
```

jules: :eyes: that looks like the KMS role was removed from the deploy SA. we merged the rbac cleanup yesterday that tightened clusterrolebindings.

satish: which PR? i touched clusterroles in infra/rbac/2026-03-19. i removed "kms.decrypt" from the deployer role because it seemed unused for non-model services.

maria: deployer role change broke GPU model startup because runtime fetches encrypted model keys at init. runtime uses the deploy SA to request KMS decrypt via the node-level agent.

kevin-oncall: rolling back the RBAC change is fine short-term. can someone /cc @platform to approve emergency revert?

deploy-bot: Deployment redwood-infer-128 failed (image pull OK, init crashloop). CI: #deploys/128 -> FAILED 14:16 UTC

auditbot: audit log snippet (k8s audit -> cloudkms):
```
{"verb":"decrypt","user":"system:serviceaccount:prod:deployer-sa","responseCode":403,"time":"2026-03-20T14:11:59Z"}
```

jules: agree with rollback. but we should make the SA least-priv: give decrypt only for that key/resource, scoped to the gpu-pool namespace, not global. current role change was overly broad (removed everything).

satish: i'm going to open an emergency PR to re-add kms:Decrypt to deployer role but scoped with a restricted condition (resource name) + namespace binding. patching now.

maria: in parallel i can restart the failed pods once rolebinding is back. those services are on a hot path, latency-sensitive.

kevin-oncall: timeline? need ETA, otherwise i'll cut the revert.

satish: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4123 — small revert + scoped grant. awaiting codeowners approval. ETA ~10m. :wrench:

maria: adding a short-term mitigation: patch runtime to fallback to cached keys if decrypt fails, with a degraded-mode metric. will open issue for follow-up.

jules: follow-ups we must capture: 1) add unit test in infra CI that runs kube audit policies against common flows (kms decrypt) 2) add RBAC change checklist that requires reviewing service dependencies 3) add a canary that validates model startup after RBAC PRs touch deploy roles

kevin-oncall: agreed. also add an alert for repeated KMS 403s in prod (SLO burn risk).

deploy-bot: PR 4123 merged by satish at 14:24 UTC.

maria: restarted pods at 14:25, all green. running acceptance evals.

auditbot: post-merge audit event shows decrypt allowed at 14:25:17Z for deployer-sa.

maria: thanks all. closing incident. creating ticket for the three follow-ups and assigning to eng-platform + eng-runtime. tag: rbac-kms-2026-03-20 :lock:

kevin-oncall: great write-up please add to postmortem if anything else emerges.

jules: note for postmortem: emphasize least-priv scoping for KMS keys and require a quick smoke of model startups when RBAC touches deploy roles.

maria: will draft a short postmortem and link PRs + audit traces.
